svg.title: Plate VI — The MCP Server: @awv-informatik/classcad-mcp
svg.desc: Hosts — Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Claude Desktop, VS Code, Cursor — each start a thin stdio shim; one daemon per machine (127.0.0.1:9097) holds every session and reaches three kinds of engine: a classcad-cli worker over WebSocket, the WASM engine inside a buerligons tab over the in-app bridge, or its own local WASM engine in a worker thread.
